startup_sequence: Read this file from current main.
Read SYSTEM-TOPOLOGY-003.json. Active peer systems are CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS. PROSE is retired historical provenance and is never an active owner.
Read system_catalog before broad project/system rediscovery. The catalog is a discovery/reuse index and never overrides topology authority.
When the user asks to build or resume a known future system/candidate, resolve its system packet before broad archive archaeology. For Programming, read programming_system_packet first.
For a System Master root chat read master_root_chat_contract. For CORE, LEARNING, BOOK or DOCUMENTS owner chats read owner_chat_contract.

Resolve requested work to SYSTEM_MASTER product-root governance, SYSTEM_MASTER/CORE, SYSTEM_MASTER/LEARNING, SYSTEM_MASTER/BOOK, SYSTEM_MASTER/DOCUMENTS, shared infrastructure, a cataloged non-active candidate, or UNALLOCATED.

Fetch every relevant live canonical control_ref. DOCUMENTS uses documents/control-v1. Do not infer a live head from chat memory, morning packets, census seals, catalog entries or historical Prose state.
Read the current completion ledger before repeating work and WORK-OBLIGATION-REGISTRY-005 before choosing what remains. Registry 004 and earlier are historical current-state evidence only.

SYSTEM-MASTER-KNOWLEDGE-RECOVERY-001 is the current central objective. Its semantic owner is SYSTEM_MASTER product-root governance; CORE administers execution because A-01 is shared Core-administered infrastructure. This split does not create a Programming peer system or a SYSTEM_MASTER root worker lane.

The first Knowledge Recovery A-01 qualification is supervised and overnight_eligible=false. Do not put it on Second Shift until its exact first receipt and deterministic catalog/trace evidence pass the acceptance gate in knowledge_recovery_control.
Read the selected expectation_registry and reallocation_ledger; prior versions remain historical evidence and may not override current topology.

No current obligation, repair transaction, Second Shift delegation or scheduled worker may route to SYSTEM_MASTER/BOOK/PROSE. If discovered, classify it RETIRED_OWNER_STALE_WORK and reconcile to DOCUMENTS or close/supersede it.

For Documents work read the current tool-owner allocation 002, Documents control record, Document admission and source-custody records. Documents is a first-class peer tool system even though execution is headless through Chat.
BOOK and DOCUMENTS are peers. BOOK owns canonical book/manuscript/lifecycle/author state. DOCUMENTS owns document/prose capability implementation and exposes admitted interfaces to BOOK.
Historical Prose exact-SHA/hosted/A-01/private/blind/author evidence remains valid only for its exact historical boundary and never transfers to changed Documents integration subjects.

Second Shift active owner lanes are discovered from SECOND-SHIFT-REGISTRY-001 owner_files and currently are CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS. PROSE and the temporary SYSTEM_MASTER root worker lane are retired from active scheduling.

When Documents completes/supersedes/materially changes its objective, reconcile DOCUMENTS-DELEGATIONS.json in the same working session and select the next Documents-owned successor, including Prose absorption work when dependency-valid.

For historical/archive reuse, read archive_source_registry, knowledge_recovery_control, the requested system packet and its ingest manifest. A-01 may verify presented bytes, manifests, schemas, provenance and exact-subject qualification but may not create or promote system identity.
Previously closed research receives the comparative/material delta gate from the historical research method; do not restart it unless current evidence supports a material reopen trigger.
Check the latest System State Reconciler and topology-validator standing before repository-wide current-state claims.
Human, author, private-data, external-authority, A-01, native-platform, publication and production boundaries remain explicit and cannot be synthesized by topology migration or catalog ingestion.

truth_classes.AUTHORITY_CURRENT: Active owner, live control head, current state and evidence agree under topology 003.
truth_classes.AUTHORITY_DELTA: Live active owner state moved after the last sealed checkpoint or packet; reconcile only the delta.
truth_classes.RETIRED_OWNER_STALE_WORK: Current metadata attempts to route execution, scheduling, repair or obligations to retired PROSE; do not execute and reconcile to DOCUMENTS or close/supersede.
truth_classes.CATALOG_CANDIDATE_ONLY: A cataloged future system/capability is discoverable but has not been admitted into active topology and has no active owner authority.
truth_classes.ARCHIVE_IDENTITY_UNPROVEN: Historical material is referenced but exact presented bytes/digest/custody are unavailable or conflicting; preserve as a gap/quarantine rather than infer identity.
truth_classes.EXTERNAL_BYTES_PENDING: A source has a stable external locator and may have a pre-stage digest, but A-01 has not actually observed the bytes and cannot call them verified.
truth_classes.UNALLOCATED: Work cannot be mapped to a current active owner path or cataloged candidate boundary.
truth_classes.STALE_DELEGATION: Second Shift delegation does not match current active owner control head or current open objective.
truth_classes.EVIDENCE_MISMATCH: Claimed standing exceeds or conflicts with exact receipt/artifact/subject evidence.
truth_classes.HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED: Machine-readable authority cannot select among valid product choices.
truth_classes.AUTHOR_DECISION_REQUIRED: Progress requires author authority automation cannot synthesize.
truth_classes.PRIVATE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: Progress requires private data authority that is not currently granted.
truth_classes.NATIVE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: Progress requires native Apple/device evidence not available from hosted execution.
truth_classes.EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: Progress requires external provider/publication/certification authority not granted by repository evidence.

write_rules: Historical evidence and exact-SHA receipts are append-only; retirement and catalog normalization never rewrite them.
Open current work belongs in WORK-OBLIGATION-REGISTRY-005 under exactly one executable owner path, with separate semantic_owner_path when product-root governance retains the decision authority.
PROSE is complete/retired and cannot receive new current work. Still-needed Prose capability integration belongs to DOCUMENTS.
Documents is first-class and must receive the same control/delegation/reconciliation treatment as Learning and Book.
Any new first-class system or parent relationship requires explicit user instruction and a superseding topology ADR/registry version; a catalog candidate cannot self-promote.
Second Shift active lane discovery comes from the registry, not a hard-coded list. Knowledge Recovery does not create a fifth peer lane.
The supervised Knowledge Recovery qualification remains overnight-ineligible until first-run acceptance is explicitly recorded.
Changed Documents integration bytes require fresh evidence; historical Prose PASS does not transfer.
BOOK canonical writes remain BOOK-owned even when BOOK consumes DOCUMENTS prose/document services.
Generated system packets are discovery caches/views. Their claims must remain traceable to source registry/catalog evidence and current authority.
A-01 catalog processing emits receipts/attestations and deterministic facts only; ambiguous semantic ownership remains an explicit decision rather than automated promotion.
